dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: I guess my neck is going to snap before I even solve this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: My neck... It hurts...

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: This is probably the ordeal all astrologers must go through. The weight of the starry sky seems to crash down on the neck when you stargaze.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: Worse yet, the hydromantic instruments in the academy fell into disrepair due to budget constraint.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: Researchers like us who aren't part of big projects must resort to more primitive measures...

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: If only the new Grand Conservator knew the value of astrology...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: Farewell. I'll have a break.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The new Grand Conservator?

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: Yes... A youngster like you should be better informed than me.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: Everyone in Sumeru City is paying close attention to the matter, be it an ordinary researcher like myself or a barber in the downtown area.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: If the new Grand Conservator is interested in astrology, he might apply for some funding and restart the use of those hydromantic instruments.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: I can also benefit from his influence and no longer have to stick out my old neck again.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: So that means... I'd prefer to have Rifaet be the next Grand Conservator.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: Thanks for your concern.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: The only consolation is that now that the Akademiya has started to work on a much more important project, they have lowered their expectations on our research productivity.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: I'll also have more time to take better care of myself now.

dialogues.speaker: Qushji
dialogues.text: Neck pain may be difficult to cure, but a healthy diet is said to be able to improve one's vision. Well, there are worse things to suffer through for a good cause...
